avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4 inducer reduces enzalutamide concentrations and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid completely; may require dose adjustment if discontinuation occurs

avoid_supplements.name: Grapefruit Seed Extract
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibitor increases enzalutamide levels and toxicity risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid; choose alternative supplements if needed

avoid_supplements.name: High-Dose Vitamin E (>400 IU daily)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May potentiate antiandrogen effects and increase bleeding risk
avoid_supplements.action: Limit to <400 IU daily or monitor for adverse effects

caution_supplements.name: Saw Palmetto
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild 5-alpha reductase inhibition may have additive antiandrogen effects
caution_supplements.action: Use with caution; monitor for increased side effects

caution_supplements.name: Cranberry Extract
caution_supplements.mechanism: May inhibit BCRP transporter affecting drug absorption
caution_supplements.action: Space dosing by 2+ hours; monitor efficacy

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and Grapefruit Juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases enzalutamide bioavailability and toxicity risk

caution_foods.name: High-Fat Meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase enzalutamide absorption; food effect variable
caution_foods.action: Take on consistent schedule relative to meals for predictable levels

caution_foods.name: Soy Products
caution_foods.mechanism: Phytoestrogen content may theoretically modulate androgen signaling
caution_foods.action: Moderate intake; no dose adjustment needed but monitor response

monitoring_notes: Monitor PSA levels, testosterone, and clinical response regularly as these reflect therapeutic efficacy. Assess for seizure risk (black box warning) and counsel patients to report new neurological symptoms, as several interactions may increase toxicity.
